name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:

theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by

  case case7 => exact Or.inr

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  let := InitStatesLength hi
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact ⟨updatedStatesInit this (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
      (InitStatesNodup hi),
      updatedStatesUpdate hl <| updatedStatesDefMonotone <| UpdateStatesDefined' hu⟩
  · simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  by_contra hx
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hcomp, hsmooth, hnonneg, hxone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_le (real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' hx))
  refine (ne_of_gt ?_) (hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right
    ⟨hsmooth, hcomp⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x))))
  simp only [inner_smul_right']
  apply (hsmooth.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hcomp.mul_right
  · intro y
    rcases (hnonneg ⟨y, rfl⟩).1.eq_or_lt with hy | hy
    · simp [← hy]
    · apply mul_nonneg hy.le
      exact hs (subset_tsupport φ hy.ne')
  · exact mul_ne_zero (hxone.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hx

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j)
    hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    hA3 (j, i)
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : _ → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext (fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1))
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt,
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    ext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
      (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt)).const_mul
      _).fun_sub ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB j) t x,
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j),
    Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
    FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, ← div_eq_mul_inv,
    ← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let q := @ι 𝓕
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  have qm := map_mul q
  have qs := map_smul q
  let m := @mulLinearMap 𝓕
  suffices h : (m.comp (m.flip c)).compr₂ₛₗ (q.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      m.compr₂ₛₗ (q.toLinearMap.comp ((m c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    congrArg (· a b) h
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  dsimp only [m, LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let eqt := fun c : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let l1 := ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) s ++
    List.filter eqt φs')
  let l2 := ofCrAnListF (List.filter eqt φs ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) s)
  have ht (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, eqt c) :
      𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF l * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
        (l1 * ofCrAnListF l * l2) := by
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list (h := hl)]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, l1, l2, s, eqt, mul_assoc]
  have h0 := ht [] (by simp)
  simp only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one] at h0
  have h12 := ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [eqt, hφψ, hψφ])
  have h21 := ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [eqt, hφψ, hψφ])
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
    ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one] at h12 h21
  rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ] at h21
  trans q (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (l1 * c * l2))
  · apply congrArg q
    simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, timeOrderF.map_sub,
      timeOrderF.map_smul, h12, h21, smul_sub]
    rw [smul_comm]
  simp only [qs, qm]
  rw [ Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
    (show q c ∈ _ from ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc, ← qm]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
      hq.symm, h0, qs, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    rfl
  · simp only [(show q c = 0 from ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq), zero_mul,
      smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => contradiction
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1
    case' inl => have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
  case' tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih |
      case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases ih rfl der.wf.2.1
  case' case.inl val =>
    obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals first
  | left
    constructor
    assumption
  | right
    try simp only [body_let, body_case] at lc
    cases lc
    aesop (config := { enableSimp := false })
      (add norm forward [canonical_form_abs, canonical_form_tabs],
        100% Red)

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
    obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha''
    obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb''
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ‹_›⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    refine ⟨_, .red_S .., ?_⟩
    apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht
    case choiceR ht => use s', ht.choiceR, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)
  all_goals
    apply Exists.imp (fun _ => And.imp (by first | exact Tr.choiceL | exact id)
      ChoiceBisim.bisim)
    first | apply h.follow_fst | apply h.follow_snd
    assumption

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let j' : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) j
  let D := fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val).ncard
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hmem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty :
      (D '' Set.univ).Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩) steps
    (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hcount : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.image₂ F Y.toFinite.toFinset Finset.univ).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro x hx
        exact Finset.mem_image₂.mpr ⟨q x, Y.toFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, _, Finset.mem_univ _, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps
          h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl⟩
      _ ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card] using
          Finset.card_image₂_le F Y.toFinite.toFinset Finset.univ
  have hfw : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j' - 1 := by
    change Y.ncard = _ at hg
    rw [hg]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have halg : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j' - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j - 1 := by
    simp only [BBF_CodeDistance, j, j', Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.sub_add_eq,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le'
        (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hmem) 2)
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ?_)
  apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcount).trans (by
    rw [←mul_assoc]
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfw).trans_eq halg)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq := fun k : Fin 2 =>
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate,
    Subtype.eq_iff] at hq
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val +
    r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    ring
  · simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, mul_sum,
      ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  refine Nat.le_induction (m := 1) ?_ ?_
  · intro u hp
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    rw [← @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F _ ⟨0⟩]
    exact hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA _ u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · rw [← @prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun n F _ ⟨0⟩
        (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      exact hp
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v n : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f n := (v n, v n.succ, v n.succ.succ, v n.succ.succ.succ)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Finite.wellQuasiOrdered Eq f
  replace hu n := congrArg Int.floor (hu _ (Nat.le_add_left 4 n)).1
  refine ⟨i, _, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  suffices f _ = f _ from congrArg (·.1.val) this.symm
  induction hn
  · rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le]
  · clear he
    simp_all +zetaDelta only [Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq,
      Int.floor_intCast, Nat.reduceSubDiff, Nat.succ_add]

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set, ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq]
  all_goals simp only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  grind
  assumption

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have step {a b} (hab : relation a b) i :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    refine (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (R := ℤ) (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => step h.1 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at hs
  intro i
  apply (IsCoprime.pow_right (n := i.1)
    (show Nat.Coprime 7 10 from rfl).isCoprime).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  exact ((hs.sub ((step h.1 i).add (step h.2 i))).sub
    (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))).trans (dvd_of_eq (by ring1))
